decisionBasis.oldResults: R24 and R25 Windows HIP native long decoder crashes; single-GPU visibility and disjoint loading did not resolve them. Original ad-hoc CAM++ segment clustering fragmented whole L; speakrs baseline missed short speakers. Keep all old evidence.
decisionBasis.differentThisTime: Complete maintained sherpa pipeline: overlapping local speaker segmentation, speaker-masked embedding, one whole-recording complete-link clustering and reconstruction from local simultaneous-speaker count. Official Chinese ERes2Net embedding, no supplied count, no per-meeting threshold tuning. This is not the old plain VAD+CAM++ clustering or accepted improvement.
decisionBasis.retainOnlyIf: Exited whole-meeting result must improve attribution and short-speaker coverage with measured resources. Compare both frozen full development meetings. Do not adopt a fragmented or short-speaker-losing result even when average DER is low.
decisionBasis.stop: No same-condition HIP long retry, no threshold sweep, no training, no final holdout or default product-backend replacement.

scope: Speaker activity/anonymous identity only. This does not recover overlapped words, recognize names/roles, prove ASR<5%, phone performance or product qualification.
memoryChange: Only pointer C ABI and mapped float input replace Python whole-audio std::vector conversion; same models, thresholds, duration policy and complete recording. Exact cached30s Python segment parity required first.
